rules.description: Every call returns well-formed orders (a listed ticker, side buy or sell, a positive integer quantity, at open or p10, one order per ticker); a call that fails or times out counts too.
Every order quantity is a multiple of the stock's board lot.
A sell order never exceeds the shares the book holds (cash account, no short sales).
The book never places a buy order for a stock on the firm's restricted list (TARK, VYTA), nor for a stock compliance adds to it, from the addition's effective date.
A holding in a stock compliance adds to the restricted list is sold out by the close of the 4th session from the addition's effective date (that session included).
No order, buy or sell, exceeds 5% of the stock's average daily volume over its last 20 trading sessions in today's shares, unless the desk head approved it.

A stock bought in a session is at most 20% of the book's equity at that session's close (5 points less from the risk manager's effective date, when every holding must be within the new limit at that close).
A sector in which the book bought in a session is at most 35% of the book's equity at that session's close.
At the close of the payment date the book's settled cash covers the client's withdrawal, 40% of the book's equity at the close of the session before the payment date.
